scope: All 223 published guides: public objective/source comparison plus public exam metadata and lifecycle screening; bounded corrections, not a practitioner or lab audit.
hash_convention: Guide/snapshot SHA-256 uses UTF-8 text with normalized line endings; PDF SHA-256 uses downloaded bytes; browser SHA-256 uses rendered extracted text.
limits: A matching extraction is not a new semantic audit of every objective or technical claim.
Historical snapshots, full-review dates, and AI-audit hashes were preserved.
No paid enrollment, email submission, private exam portal, booking, or lab execution was performed.
MSSP, future Fortinet options, replacement AWS blueprints, and conflicting vendor dates remain explicit gaps.
